title: Aravalli Biodiversity Park Delhi - Timings, Entry Fee, Attractions & Travel Guide
content:
Aravalli Biodiversity Park - Delhi, 

Aravalli Biodiversity Park in Delhi is one of the city’s most refreshing green escapes. Spread over a wide area on the ancient Aravalli hills, this park is more than just a place for morning walks or picnics. It is a carefully designed natural reserve created to protect Delhi’s environment and restore its native plants and wildlife. With open walking trails, thick greenery, chirping birds, and colorful butterflies, the park feels like a different world compared to the busy streets outside. It is a perfect place for those who love peace, nature, and eco-friendly travel.

History:

The land where the park stands today was once a degraded mining site. Over time, efforts were made to turn it into an ecological zone that brings back native species of the Aravalli hills. Today, the park is a success story in restoring biodiversity, with thousands of trees, medicinal plants, and wildlife thriving here.

What to See:

Visitors to Aravalli Biodiversity Park can explore walking trails surrounded by dense greenery, see migratory and resident birds, spot butterflies, and even enjoy guided nature walks. The park has different zones dedicated to plants and animals, giving you a chance to experience Delhi’s natural heritage up close. Early mornings are the best time to enjoy the sounds of nature here.

Attractions at Aravalli Biodiversity Park:

  • Walking Trails - Long paths surrounded by greenery and wild plants.
  • Birdwatching - Spot various migratory and local birds.
  • Butterfly Zone - Beautiful butterflies fluttering around flowering plants.
  • Nature Photography - Perfect place for capturing sunrise, sunset, and wildlife.
  • Peaceful Environment - A calm spot away from city traffic and noise.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Vasant Vihar, New Delhi.
  • Timings: 5:00 AM – 7:00 PM (open all days).
  • Entry Fee: Free for all visitors.
  • Parking: Available near the entrance.

Best Time to Visit: You can visit the park any day of the year, but October to March is the most comfortable time when the weather is cool and perfect for walking or exploring.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest metro station is Vasant Vihar Metro Station (Magenta Line), about 2 km from the park.
  • By Bus: DTC buses regularly run to Vasant Vihar and nearby areas.
  • By Car/Auto: Easy access with parking facility at the site.

Nearby Places to Visit:

  • Deer Park - Hauz Khas,
  • Garden of Five Senses
  • Qutub Minar

Travel Tip: Carry a water bottle and wear comfortable shoes for walking, as the trails are long and natural.
